$105,000 of bona fide debt with Cronin Capital by issuing 700,000 units at $0.15 per unit.
Each unit includes one common share and half a warrant, with each whole warrant exercisable at $0.30 per share for 36 months.
Because Cronin Capital is controlled by a former company director, the transaction may qualify as a related-party transaction.
The company expects to issue the settlement units around September 18, 2026.

title: NU E Power settles $105K debt with shares and warrants
